fields.description: Sobha One is a five-tower apartment and duplex development beside Ras Al Khor Road. The linked buildings step from 30 to 65 storeys around landscaped courtyards, with a neighbouring 18-hole pitch-and-putt course and a broad choice of indoor and outdoor space arrangements.

overview: The original brochure includes two- to four-bedroom duplexes in addition to apartments. Outdoor areas vary materially: a balcony, terrace or yard may form part of the quoted saleable size. The Element and Golf Ridges are separate named products and their delivery dates or unit specifications are not imported here.
research.locationNote: Near Ras Al Khor Road in Dubai, with different tower orientations toward the Creek, Downtown and the golf setting. Views shown in marketing depend on the actual unit and future surroundings.
research.priceNote: Sobha currently advertises AED 1.74 m subject to inventory. The original brochure’s AED 1.1 m guide is historical; Property Finder’s sold-out label and AED 1.6 m launch guide do not establish today’s availability.
research.paymentNote: The official brochure states 60% during construction and 40% on completion. Property Finder breaks the first 60% into 20% launch down payment and 40% construction. Remaining instalments, transfer balances and current offers depend on the selected contract.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder estimates December 2026. No signed current handover schedule was retrieved; do not substitute The Element’s separate 2028 date.
